st.t: Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square.
s: Yes, I have seen her actually!
Yes, ok, I'll let her know.

st.t: Go up the stairs in the house west of Varrock West Bank and talk to Juliet on the upper floor.
Bring the letter to Romeo in Varrock Square.
Talk to Father Lawrence in north east Varrock.
Bring cadava berries to the Apothecary in south west Varrock. If you don't have any, pick some from the bushes just west of the south-east Varrock mine.
Bring the potion to Juliet in the house west of Varrock.
Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square to finish the quest.
